message: Email 1, draft 1: "Manage team access with CleanShot Pro"
subject: Manage team access with CleanShot Pro
preview_text: Bring the Mac capture app, SSO and SCIM under one team plan.
body:
CleanShot Pro combines screenshot and screen recording software for Mac with centralized access management, SSO and SCIM. It gives IT one team plan for managing access instead of treating CleanShot only as individually purchased software.

> **$10 per user/month** — billed annually

Each seat requires macOS 13.0 or newer, and the Mac app stays up to date while the Pro subscription is active.

CleanShot does not offer a direct free trial. Instead, your paid evaluation is covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee. If CleanShot does not meet your expectations, contact support within that period for a full refund.

Begin the subscription to evaluate whether CleanShot Pro’s team-access model fits your Mac team.

message: Email 1, draft 2: "A Pro plan for Mac teams"
subject: A Pro plan for Mac teams
preview_text: Centralize CleanShot access with single sign-on and Scim.
body:
With CleanShot Pro, an admin can bring screenshot and screen-recording seats under centralized access management, with single sign-on and Scim. It turns CleanShot’s Mac app into software managed through one team plan.

The Pro plan costs **$10 per user/month, billed annually**. Each subscribed seat includes the always-up-to-date Mac app and requires macOS 13.0 or newer.

There is no direct free trial, so evaluation starts with a paid subscription. The purchase is covered by a **30-day money-back guarantee**; if CleanShot does not meet your expectations, contact support within that period for a full refund.
